body.label: Trigger
body.html: A linked or allied creature within 5 units suffers damage or a normal Condition.

body.label: Effect
body.html: You may take 1 of the damage or receive that Condition instead. If you do, the original creature gains +1 Defense until its next turn.

surges.html: One non-damage benefit from this Reaction persists until the start of your next turn.
If this Reaction affects an enemy, it burns 1 die on its next hostile Action.
